claims: The page reports 530 Pokémon, seven generations and more than 25 guides.
The route reports 910 Pokémon rows and displays normal and Shiny variants as separate rows sharing a Pokédex number.
Ultra Rare, Legendary and Mythic are rarity classifications for Shiny variants.
The classification does not necessarily mean the species is legendary in the traditional Pokédex.
The guide states that these variants appear naturally only in compatible Primal Areas and does not disclose exact rates.
Star Ascension consumes a compatible Pokémon and has a maximum of five Stars.
Compatibility generally requires the same species, tier and current Star count.
Pokémon with Stars cannot receive Mega Stone according to the current guide.

evidence.locator: basic information, evolution and PVE moves
claims: Chimchar is displayed with Pokédex number 390, HP 470, experience 1575, required level 30, tier 6 and PVE function.
The page displays evolution to Monferno and a slotted move list with cooldown and element.
The repository includes broad JSON datasets but the sampled records do not include per-record source or verification metadata.
Rules may change and players must follow announcements in official channels.
Trade of items and Pokémon within the game is permitted.
Account sharing is permitted at the player's responsibility.
RMT is permitted outside official channels, while RMT price advertisements in official game, Discord or forum channels are prohibited.
PokeAlliance disclaims responsibility for transactions performed outside the game.
Bots, macros, hacks and software that interferes with or automates the game are prohibited.
Sharing or requesting another player's personal information is prohibited.
Supplied rule 6 permits use of client and wiki information to build community wikis and tools and says contributions to community knowledge are rewarded.

evidence.locator: project-owner message accompanying Discord rules transcription
claims: The project owner reports that the current Server Save occurs at 00:00 Brazil time.
The project owner observes a current local conversion of 21:00 in America/Monterrey on the previous date.
The local installation contains 8,075 files totaling approximately 809.7 MB.
Client modules expose named surfaces for minimap, Pokedex, moves, item drops, hunts, quests, NPCs, market, Stars, berries and other game systems.
Packaged Lua, OTML and PNG-labeled assets sampled during this pass use protected or nonstandard encodings and were not decoded by bypassing client protections.
The stable snapshot is an OTMM v1 minimap cache containing 33,501 blocks across floors 0 through 15.
The snapshot parser counted 30,094,994 tiles carrying the WasSeen flag and 23,970,804 colored tile records.
The cache currently has no verified semantic mapping from coordinates to cities, hunts, NPCs, quests or teleport destinations.
The reference implementation defines the OTMM signature, versioned header, 64 by 64 blocks, zlib compression and three-byte tile records.

evidence.locator: requirements, city unlock and destination tables
claims: Teleport requires Premium, an active compatible Pokémon, an unlocked destination, no active battle and a permitted area.
A city is unlocked by visiting its Pokémon Center and speaking with its Nurse or Nurse Joy.
Saffron is listed as a Kanto destination with the command h "saffron.

evidence.locator: attributes, charges and level lock sections
claims: A Normal charger adds 20,000 standard-progress training charges.
A Premium charger adds 20,000 charges and grants 20% additional training experience.
The Punching Bag stores at most 100,000 charges and accepts a complete refill only at 80,000 charges or less.
Charger types cannot be mixed while charges of the previous type remain.
Scratch is displayed in Chimchar's PVE move table at slot M1, with a 12-second cooldown and Normal element.
The table provides move slot, name, cooldown and element but does not provide damage formula or AoE geometry.
The launcher cache contains 20 news records with stable IDs, categories, titles, HTML bodies and creation timestamps.
The cached feed was updated at 2026-09-04T06:46:00Z.
A 2026-08-09 changelog states that Nurse, Mark and Fisherman markers were added to the minimap, a marker legend was added, and city names became clickable Teleport destinations.
A 2026-08-19 changelog states that more than 500 client texts were translated to Portuguese and Spanish while move, item and tier names intentionally remained in English.
The cached launcher terms identify their last update as 2026-06-11.
The cached document repeats that RMT is permitted outside official channels and advertisements are prohibited in official channels.
Section 6 of this terms document concerns account responsibility, not community use of assets or wiki/client information.
The terms point to https://pokealliance.com/termsofservice as the current-version location.
The client-local Minimap.flags block contains 119 coordinate-bearing records with x, y and z values plus icon indices.
The extracted descriptions include 57 Pokemon Center markers, 44 Poke Mart markers and 11 Fisherman markers; four records have no description.
The records span floors 1 through 9 in this client configuration snapshot.
The public official roster endpoint returns 910 records with identity, variant, level, tier, role and element fields but no coordinate or location fields.
Sampled official detail payloads did not expose a structured spawn-coordinate table.
The pinned community location, Hoenn hunt and task datasets contain area/image-link or NPC lead fields but no x/y/z coordinate records.
The official teleport guide is a semantic city/destination source only; it does not establish coordinate points.

evidence.locator: requirements, entry, time limit, puzzle, reward and permanent-access sections
claims: The quest requires level 200, speaking with Dr. Vektor and accepting the research task.
The instance is entered through the computer beside Dr. Vektor and has a 45-minute limit.
The final encounter is Giant Porygon; the listed rewards include experience, Empty Alliance Ball, Empty Yume Ball, Enhanced Normal Stone and permanent access to the Porygon-area computer.
The page does not provide NPC or area coordinates.

evidence.locator: Hoenn Hunts list; per-entry View map links
claims: The community wiki lists 137 Hoenn/Tubos hunt entries with Pokémon names and type labels.
Entries expose external View map links, including Imgur albums such as the Mewtwo Island album.
The rendered hunt index does not expose structured x/y/z coordinate or floor fields; linked map images remain visual evidence requiring manual review.
